incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010, of 2 July, approving the consolidated text of the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), especially Articles 20-23, 62-64, 133, 175-177 and 219; Royal Decree 1784/1996 approving the Mercantile Registry Regulation; Law 14/2013 on support for entrepreneurs where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) for the corporate-name certificate; Provincial Mercantile Registry of the registered office for the inscription of the public deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation), together with the corporate by-laws, negative name certificate, bank capital-deposit certificate or expert valuation of non-cash contributions, and the Mercantile Registry filing application.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada requires minimum share capital of EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash at incorporation. The paid-in capital must be evidenced by a bank certificate of deposit issued in the name of the future company and held in a blocked escrow account until registration; non-cash contributions require an independent expert valuation report under Article 72 LSC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDERS AND DIRECTORS OF [●], SOCIEDAD DE RESPONSABILIDAD LIMITADA. The founders and appointed directors, acting unanimously, RESOLVE THAT: (1) the subscription and payment of the share capital are approved in accordance with Article 62 of the Spanish Companies Act; (2) the registered office of the company is fixed at [address], [city], Spain; (3) [name] is appointed as Administrador Único/Solidary Joint Administrator, with full corporate powers; (4) the managers shall complete the Mercantile Registry filing and apply for the definitive tax identification number; (5) the managers are authorized to open bank accounts and to submit the customs representative authorization and all municipal operating license applications. This resolution is executed and recorded on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Negative Name Certificate from the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid (electronic application via the official RMC portal or a notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for certification that the proposed corporate name is not already registered, selecting at least two alternative names in descending order. Wait for the certification and verify that its validity period will cover the date of the notarial deed. This certificate must be presented to the notary at execution of the deed.
required_dossiers: Completed official name-certificate application form
Proposed corporate name and alternative names
Identity documents or passports of the incorporators
Power of attorney if a representative signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, select a new alternative and resubmit; if the certificate expires before use, obtain a fresh certificate at no prejudice to the founders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Minimum Share Capital in a Spanish Bank Escrow Account and Obtain Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution selected by the founders, or a notary where notarial deposit is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the future company, deposit at least EUR 3,000, and request a certificate of deposit addressed to the notary. For non-cash contributions, prepare the in-kind inventory and obtain an expert valuation in accordance with Articles 67-72 LSC. The capital must remain blocked until the company is registered.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Draft by-laws
Founders' identification documents and NIE numbers
Bank account-opening forms and source-of-funds declaration
Expert valuation report if non-cash contributions are made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank certificate is incomplete or incorrect, request a corrected certificate; if the bank declines the deposit, use a notarial escrow or adjust the contribution schedule to comply with the minimum capital rule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute Public Deed of Incorporation Before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary (Notaría) of the province where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders or their legal representatives appear before the notary with all required documents. The notary verifies legal capacity, lawfulness of the by-laws, and the reality of the capital contribution, reads the deed, and obtains signatures. The deed must contain the corporate name, object, registered office, capital, administrators, and the bylaws. Request a first copy for Mercantile Registry filing.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate in force
Bank capital-deposit certificate or expert valuation report
Draft by-laws and shareholder agreement, if any
Passports or national identity documents and NIE of all founders
Proof of address and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects deficiencies, amend the by-laws or cure the capital-evidence defects before signing; if refusal is unlawful, engage another notary or request administrative guidance from the Notarial College.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the first notarial copy and supporting forms to the Mercantile Registry, together with the applicable prescribed fee. The registrar conducts a legal qualification review of the deed and by-laws. Upon satisfactory review, the company is inscribed, thereby acquiring full legal personality, and a registry certificate may be obtained for subsequent licensing.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Payment form for registry fees if invoiced
NIE or identification documents of the administrators
Statement of registered office and declaration of no disqualification of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a negative qualification, correct the identified defects within the statutory period and re-file; if the refusal persists, file an appeal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública or the competent civil court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for the Definitive Tax Identification Number (NIF) with the State Tax Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), local tax office or electronic office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 036 (census declaration) to obtain or regularise the corporate NIF, attaching the public deed and the Mercantile Registry inscription certificate. If a provisional NIF was obtained before registration, present the inscription certificate to convert it into a definitive NIF. This NIF is required for AEAT customs authorization and other administrative licences.
required_dossiers: Form 036 or 030 where applicable
First copy of the public deed and registration certificate
NIE of the legal representative
Power of attorney if representative is appointed
Lease contract or ownership title proving the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the application, complete or correct Form 036 and provide the missing registered-office or representation evidence; the NIF certificate will be reissued upon compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Customs and Excise Department (Departamento de Aduanas e Impuestos Especiales), together with the municipal ayuntamiento for local opening and operating licences; Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism may be relevant for ancillary logistics registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Representante Aduanero (Customs Representative Authorization under Article 39 of the Union Customs Code) and Licencia de Apertura y Funcionamiento (Municipal Opening and Operation License)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental of the Ministry for Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO), and the competent environmental department of the autonomous community
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA as an administrative-office activity; where bonded storage or transit facilities are included, the facility is subject to simplified environmental registration or a municipal environmental licence under the applicable regional catalogue.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial VOC emissions arise from customs brokerage; sanitary wastewater must meet municipal sewer discharge limits; if warehouses are operated, stormwater controls, waste segregation, and hazardous-waste handling must comply with Law 7/2022 and Royal Decree 1055/2022 on packaging waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the local fire department after inspection; certificate of structural occupancy or building load capacity for the commercial premises; municipal opening licence; mandatory workplace risk-prevention assessment and plan under Law 31/1995 and Royal Decree 486/1997; emergency evacuation, first-aid, and health and safety signage verified by the competent labour authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Spanish Tax Agency, official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities must obtain NIE (Número de Identificación Fiscal) via AEAT online registration or in-person submission at tax offices; provide corporate charter, proof of activity, and power of attorney. VAT identification number (NIF) issued post-registration if economic nexus established. Foreign SL entities register as non-residents for Spanish-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections available; Spanish SL entities are subject to mandatory entity-level corporate taxation. Limited hybrid mismatch and CFC rules apply under Spanish and EU directives; no elective regimes for tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 30,000 EUR annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing standard for all VAT-registered taxpayers; real-time fiscal reporting via AEAT systems with API integration required for large taxpayers. Customs brokerage operations require digital stamping and bonded transit declarations through integrated customs platforms.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods physically exported outside the EU or services performed for non-EU recipients. Eligibility requires proof of export, non-EU destination, and compliance with customs formalities; offshore services to non-EU clients qualify under territorial scope rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Recepción de Divisas)
Proof of non-EU destination and transport
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT conducts post-export audits; fraudulent zero-rating claims result in 30% surcharge, interest accrual, and retrospective VAT clawback. Penalties include fines up to 100,000 EUR, administrative sanctions, and criminal prosecution for intentional fraud with potential imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) in coordination with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCIIN) of the Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo; the regime is framed by TFEU Articles 63-66, Ley 19/1992, Ley 10/2010, and Banco de España Circular 4/2012 on balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EUR is fully convertible; Spain maintains no capital controls on current or capital account movements. Profit remittance is unrestricted, subject to a 19% non-resident dividend withholding tax (reduced or exempt under applicable tax treaties). Statistical filing obligations apply: direct foreign investment and cross-border financing flows must be declared ex-post (within 30 days) to the Banco de España / DGCIIN registers where thresholds are met; no prior foreign-exchange authorization is required for EUR-denominated flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender ratio or mandatory conversion applies to export proceeds realized in EUR; invoicing in EUR or any freely agreed currency is permitted. Exporters must file statistical declarations (SAD for extra-EU and INTRASTAT for intra-EU trade) and comply with balance-of-payments reporting, but may retain 100% of proceeds without forced conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account plus Escrow/Client Money Account
Operational Account with Integrated Aduana Payment Module

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium viability. A PSD2-licensed electronic money institution (Spanish entity or EU passport through the freedom of services) may hold segregated operational balances and route disbursements via SEPA/SWIFT; however, EMIs cannot issue the aval bancario (bank guarantee) normally required for the customs-broker statutory bond, are not universally admitted on the AEAT Código Cuenta Tributaria (CCT) debt-collection rails, and offer no trade finance. EMIs are therefore suitable as secondary disbursement rails, not as the primary treasury anchor.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Medium_Risk_Enhanced customs brokerage, Spanish banks require physical presence at the initial KYC interview of at least the administrador único (managing director) with personal identity documentation; where the UBO is non-resident, an apostilled, officially translated power of attorney is also required. Pure video-KYC may be accepted only where the bank model complies with SEPBLAC guidance, but in practice fully remote opening is not a viable default and a first in-person meeting with the statutory officer is mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory license holder acting as agent for multiple importers creates third-party payment opacity (interposition risk).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the customs-broker license (habilitación), customs representation mandates listing each principal, standard agency contract template, register of principals with NIFs, and the professional surety bond policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity inbound/outbound wires to AEAT and customs authorities that may resemble layering of public-money flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CCT payment receipts, AEAT settlement certificates (DUAs and customs settlement summaries), monthly reconciliation of duty payments vs. receivables ledger, and a controls memorandum confirming duty amounts never pass through the commission margin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident LatAm UBO or PEP exposure in the ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled company registry extract, full UBO chain declaration, passport copies, foreign tax residency certificate, source-of-funds evidence (foreign bank statements, audited accounts), and PEP screening result with a compliance risk approval file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionate cash or manual deposits attributed to customs duties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Zero-cash policy memorandum, Modelo 347 annual statement of third-party transactions, cash origin declarations, and internal control policy restricting duty payments to traceable bank transfers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction velocity exceeding the onboarding turnover profile of a new SL in its first operating year.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month management or audited accounts, annual transaction budget and dashboard, previous bank reference letter, and the customs broker professional indemnity insurance certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders may wire EUR via SWIFT MT103 with the balance-of-payments purpose codes C1.1 (new direct investment) or C2.1 (capital participation), referencing the SL NIF; funds must be segregated into the designated operational capital account and recorded in the Banco de España investment declaration (Form D-1A) within 30 days. No prior central bank authorization is required, but the receiving bank will demand the notarized capital-increase deed (escritura de ampliación de capital), a bank contribution certificate (certificado bancario) showing funds credited to the company account, and the updated registry of shareholders to legalize the capital injection before the Registro Mercantil.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Import duties and VAT payments are executed through the AEAT CCT telematic rails (direct charge to the bank CCT account using the DUA reference) via SEPA for EUR or SWIFT for non-EUR. Payments to non-EU suppliers use SWIFT MT103 (direct transfer) or a documentary credit via SWIFT MT700 where a Commercial LC is opened; MT202-COV is used when correspondent funding is required. Broker commission income is invoiced and collected separately through SEPA direct debit, never commingled with the duty-disbursement rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/MXN deliverable forwards
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for restricted-delivery LatAm currencies (ARS, VES, USD-based BOP) settled in EUR
Cross-currency swaps (EUR vs USD/MXN) under ISDA 2002 with CSA collateral annex
FX options and zero-cost collars for budget-rate certainty on core clearance corridors
Rolling daily spot-based hedges implemented under a board-approved FX policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Cuentas Anuales (filing of annual accounts after shareholder approval)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-deposit triggers administrative fines and closure of the company's registry file, preventing registration of corporate acts; prolonged default may lead to judicial dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after six months following year-end; for a 31 December financial year, by 25 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharges from 5% to 20% based on delay and late-payment interest; late filing penalties starting from EUR 200 and rising with administrative sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Modelo 190 annual withholding and advance payment return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incorrect or late filing is subject to fixed penalties under the General Tax Law, graded by the nature and number of data items reported.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Modelo 347 annual information report on third-party business transactions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 28 February following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, incomplete filing, or delayed presentation carries monetary penalties per data item, subject to an aggregate administrative maximum.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of mandatory statutory books and corporate registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the annual close; for a 31 December year-end, by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalised books lose evidentiary value and the company may be fined; registry closure prevents subsequent filings until the books are legalized.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An SL must mandatorily audit if, for two consecutive years, it meets at least two of the following: total assets above EUR 2,850,000; net turnover above EUR 5,700,000; or average workforce above 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) for individual accounts; IFRS as adopted by the EU for consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain requires continuous UBO registration with the Mercantile Registry rather than a standalone annual UBO filing; any change in beneficial ownership must be declared within one month. The annual accounts deposit serves as the principal annual review point for reconciling registered UBO data.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Contracts and Corporate Books Pursuant to Mercantile Registry Rules

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,000-8,000 for a small to mid-cap SL when audit is mandatory; audit waiver otherwise

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holidays; deductions for R&D investments, training expenses, reinvestment of profits, and certain regional incentives in autonomous communities

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Impuesto sobre Sociedades via AEAT Electronic Filing System (www.aeat.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25th day of the fourth month following the end of the tax period (e.g., 25 April for calendar year-end 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before deductions and exemptions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only Spanish source income; permanent establishment adjustments required if applicable
Limited to Spanish-source expenses and qualifying deductions only
Final calculation of Spanish tax liability after all adjustments

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 100 euros per day late filing penalty (maximum 20,000 euros); 1% monthly interest on unpaid tax; potential criminal sanctions for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% (reduced to 0% under most double tax treaties and EU directives)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Apply for Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) to AEAT with supporting documentation; obtain prior approval before dividend distribution
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory rate; Interest: 19% statutory rate, frequently reduced to 0% under applicable tax treaties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 6,000,000 euros (annual turnover threshold for local file obligation)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: General substance requirements under Spanish GAAR; specific rules for IP holding companies; operational presence in Spain required for customs brokerage activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or false statement in corporate tax return to reduce tax liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including fines equivalent to 40% of evaded tax or imprisonment up to 2 years; additional civil penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for restitution, fines, and possible disqualification or imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Spanish SL with no real economic activity or substance in Spain
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of transactions as non-existent; fines up to 5% of corporate assets or 300,000 euros
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; personal tax liability and criminal liability for fraudulent conduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform due diligence or report suspicious transactions in customs brokerage operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 2 million euros or 2% of annual turnover; possible license suspension
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines up to 300,000 euros and criminal prosecution for willful negligence

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Absence of contemporaneous TP documentation or failure to justify intra-group transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority adjustments increasing taxable income; penalties up to 100% of understated tax plus interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint liability for additional taxes and potential criminal sanctions for bad faith
